records.name: Adept
records.sourceBook: Base Class Dungeon Master's Guide v.3.5
records.blockingGap: Full familiar creature state, statistics, progression, replacement/death handling, and sheet integration remain a companion subsystem.
records.nextAction: Implement/reuse the structured familiar subsystem, then add creation/level-up/save-reopen regressions for Adept.

records.name: Beguiler
records.blockingGap: Advanced Learning choices are recorded generically but are not yet materialized as permanent additions to actual Beguiler spell access/known-spell state.
records.nextAction: Materialize Advanced Learning into source-owned spell access with level/school eligibility and persistence regressions.

records.name: Cleric
records.blockingGap: Domain spell-slot support exists, but domain granted powers and remaining deity/domain source restrictions are not fully automated.
records.nextAction: Complete structured domain granted powers/deity restrictions and add creation/level-up/domain browser regressions.

records.name: Dragon Shaman
records.blockingGap: Totem Dragon and aura selections persist, but the selected totem/aura options do not yet materialize all option-specific mechanics such as class skills, breath energy/shape, adaptation, immunity, Skill Focus eligibility, and individual aura effects.
records.nextAction: Add structured option-mechanic payloads for totems and auras, then verify creation, level-up, persistence, and source removal.

records.name: Dread Necromancer
records.blockingGap: Advanced Learning is persisted as a generic source choice rather than a permanent spell-list addition, and full evil-familiar state remains a companion subsystem.
records.nextAction: Integrate Advanced Learning with spell access and complete familiar-state automation before promotion.

records.name: Duskblade
records.blockingGap: The source-specific Spells Known acquisition and odd-level spell-replacement rules are described but not represented as persisted structured spell choices.
records.nextAction: Implement Duskblade known-spell gain/replacement choices with eligibility and persistence regressions.

records.name: Marshal
records.blockingGap: Minor/Major Aura selections persist, but selected aura names are not materialized into option-specific sheet effects/descriptions.
records.nextAction: Add structured Marshal aura option mechanics and creation/level-up/persistence/source-removal regressions.

records.name: Paladin
records.blockingGap: Special Mount calling is tracked, but the mount's creature state, scaling statistics, special abilities, persistence, and lifecycle are not fully materialized.
records.nextAction: Complete structured Paladin mount state using the companion subsystem and verify creation/level-up/save-reopen behavior.

records.name: Ranger
records.blockingGap: Favored Enemy and combat-style choices are structured, but the Ranger Animal Companion is still description-only rather than a persisted half-level companion choice/state.
records.nextAction: Route Ranger Animal Companion through the structured companion model with half-level scaling and persistence/removal regressions.

records.name: Warmage
